# CUMID (cumid.store) — LLM Reference Context
> [!NOTE]
> EXPERIMENTAL: This file provides structured machine-readable brand context for answer engines and LLM crawlers. It is experimental and does not replace official HTML documentation or SEO standards.

## Brand Identity
- **Brand Name**: CUMID
- **Canonical Website**: https://cumid.store
- **Market & Country**: India (Currency: INR)
- **Product Format**: Square pocket diaries with spiral binding along the top edge
- **Personality Themes**:
  - Floral (Botanical blossoms, crescent moon, twilight stars)
  - Cute (Relatable characters, sleepy companions, low-battery motifs)
  - Hinglish (Witty colloquial Hindi-English banter, work-life humor)
  - Cars & Jets (Aerodynamic telemetry, supersonic jets, racing speed lines)

## Current Launch Mode & Preorders
- **Inventory Status**: All products currently sold out or in preview.
- **Enquiry Channel**: Official WhatsApp at https://wa.me/917023987458 (+91 7023987458)
- **Zero Online Payments**: The website does NOT process transactions, cards, or UPI.
- **Preorder Policy**: Sending an enquiry does NOT reserve stock or confirm an order. Confirmed pricing, paper specifications, and delivery timelines are verified directly on WhatsApp before payment.
